testing_attributes.data_testid_requirement: ALL interactive components, navigation links, forms, buttons, table inputs, admin login, and dialogs MUST have unique descriptive data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts for 'Cormorant Garamond', 'Alex Brush', and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' in public/index.html or index.css.
Set default background to warm cream (#FAF6F0) for public sections and rich wood (#2C1A14) for dark sections/hero.
Ensure header nav contains links to all 11 public pages + Admin login entry.
Use direct path references for local uploaded restaurant images: /restaurant/image1.jpeg through /restaurant/image7.jpeg.
Include JWT authentication flow for the /admin dashboard route with tabbed CMS controls for Bookings, Content Editor, Global Settings, Menu Items, and Offers.
Provide responsive drawer/sheet menu for mobile viewports, while keeping desktop top navigation clean and slim.
Verify all interactive buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and form submissions carry appropriate kebab-case data-testid attributes.
